questions.text: I speak honestly even when it requires a kind but difficult conversation.
People rely on me to keep our shared values visible.
I come alive through music, images, storytelling, or creative expression.
I enjoy making a complex idea memorable and inspiring.
I naturally notice who needs listening, reassurance, or practical support.
I can stay present with someone without trying to fix their feelings.
Quiet reflection helps me return to a sense of inner steadiness.
I protect time for rest rather than measuring my worth only by activity.
Caring for land, water, plants, or animals feels like meaningful service.
A relationship with nature helps me feel connected and grounded.
I enjoy investigating unfamiliar ideas before deciding what I believe.
I want to understand how different parts of a system work together.
I help people with different perspectives find a workable shared direction.
I notice relationships and connections that others might overlook.
A spiritual insight matters to me when I can apply it to everyday life.
I find satisfaction in dependable follow-through and useful small actions.
I readily imagine new ways of living, learning, or creating community.
Symbols, dreams, and imaginative reflection help me explore meaning.
I can take responsibility for a project while inviting other people to contribute.
I am willing to make my gifts visible in service of something I care about.
Ocean or water imagery brings me a feeling of connection.
Birds, flight, and a wider perspective are meaningful symbols to me.
Feline imagery reminds me of courage, dignity, and self-possession.
Precise patterns, sacred geometry, or intricate systems hold my attention.
I feel drawn to making peace between very different ways of seeing the world.
I am curious about stories of human potential and conscious evolution.
I would rather explore a teaching through quiet contemplation before sharing it.
I enjoy turning a beautiful vision into a repeatable practice.
I feel drawn to sound, resonance, or music as a contemplative practice.
My sense of service includes people beyond my immediate circle.

lineages.name: Elohei-Elohim
lineages.location: Lyra; Aramatena in the MCEO cosmology
lineages.locationNote: Founder consciousness collective; associated with dimensions 13-15, with the Anuhazi expression at Lyra-Aramatena.
lineages.background: The Emerald founder family is described as a source of feline and land-mammal expressions and as a guardian collective.
lineages.practice: Bring integrity into a promise, a project, or a difficult conversation.
lineages.source: Dance for Life (A & A Deane, 2002), printed pp. 136-139
lineages.interpretation: Personality themes and practices are New Earth University interpretations, not an MCEO diagnostic method.

lineages.name: Seraphei-Seraphim
lineages.location: Lyra; Vega in the MCEO cosmology
lineages.locationNote: Founder consciousness collective; the Cerez and Aethien expressions are linked with Lyra-Vega.
lineages.background: The Gold founder family includes avian and mantis expressions in the primary teachings.
lineages.practice: Give a meaningful idea a clear voice or a beautiful form.
lineages.source: Dance for Life (A & A Deane, 2002), printed pp. 136-139
lineages.interpretation: Personality themes and practices are New Earth University interpretations, not an MCEO diagnostic method.

lineages.name: Bra-ha-Rama
lineages.location: Lyra; Aveyon in the MCEO cosmology
lineages.locationNote: Founder consciousness collective; Inyu and Pegasai are connected with Lyra-Aveyon.
lineages.background: The Amethyst founder family includes cetacean and winged horse-deer expressions.
lineages.practice: Create a small practice that makes room for compassion and restoration.
lineages.source: Dance for Life (A & A Deane, 2002), printed pp. 136-139
lineages.interpretation: Personality themes and practices are New Earth University interpretations, not an MCEO diagnostic method.

lineages.name: Anuhazi
lineages.locationNote: Lyra-Aramatena is named as the Anuhazi origin within this cosmology. It is not an astronomically verified inhabited planet.
lineages.background: The texts describe feline hominids, sometimes called Lyran-Sirian Whites, within the Emerald family.
lineages.practice: Name one boundary and one courageous contribution you can practice this week.
lineages.source: Dance for Life (A & A Deane, 2002), printed pp. 136-139; Voyagers II: The Secrets of Amenti (expanded edition), printed pp. 262-264
lineages.interpretation: Personality themes and practices are New Earth University interpretations, not an MCEO diagnostic method.

lineages.name: Anyu
lineages.location: Lyra; Aveyon in Dance for Life
lineages.locationNote: The supplied summary describes an aquatic ape-like branch. Dance for Life more specifically names an aquatic feline-ape hybrid at Lyra-Aveyon.
lineages.background: A distinct branch in the teachings; do not confuse Anyu with the Yonei aquatic-ape expression. Source moral labels are not applied to assessment participants.
lineages.practice: Explore water or nature as a reflective setting while keeping practical boundaries.
lineages.source: Dance for Life (A & A Deane, 2002), printed pp. 136-139; supplied Founder family races reference
lineages.interpretation: Personality themes and practices are New Earth University interpretations, not an MCEO diagnostic method.

lineages.name: Cerez / Carians
lineages.locationNote: The founder narrative locates the Cerez avian expression at Lyra-Vega.
lineages.background: Bird-like hominids in the Gold order. Cerez is distinct from the similarly spelled Ceres, Seres, and Serres in other accounts.
lineages.practice: Share a short teaching through your voice, writing, or visual expression.
lineages.source: Dance for Life (A & A Deane, 2002), printed pp. 136-139; Voyagers II: The Secrets of Amenti (expanded edition), printed pp. 262-264
lineages.interpretation: Personality themes and practices are New Earth University interpretations, not an MCEO diagnostic method.

lineages.name: Aethien
lineages.location: Lyra-Vega founder context; Pegasus guardian association
lineages.locationNote: Dance for Life locates the founder expression at Lyra-Vega. Angelic Realities, p. xxix, identifies the illustrated Guardian Aethien as Gold Order, Mantis, Pegasus System. These are different source contexts; no exact personal planet is assigned.
lineages.background: Mantis-like beings in the Gold order, included in the founders of the IAFW service organization.
lineages.practice: Study a practice deeply, then translate one insight into a simple helpful step.
lineages.source: Dance for Life (A & A Deane, 2002), printed pp. 136-139; Angelic Realities, printed p. xxix
lineages.interpretation: Personality themes and practices are New Earth University interpretations, not an MCEO diagnostic method.

lineages.name: Inyu
lineages.locationNote: Lyra-Aveyon is the named founder setting; additional Inyu affiliations appear in the Alcyone-Pleiades council narrative.
lineages.background: Cetacean or whale-like expressions associated with the Amethyst founder family.
lineages.practice: Pair a contemplative sound practice with a concrete act of water stewardship.
lineages.source: Dance for Life (A & A Deane, 2002), printed pp. 136-139
lineages.interpretation: Personality themes and practices are New Earth University interpretations, not an MCEO diagnostic method.

lineages.name: Pegasai / Pegasi
lineages.locationNote: The founders text places Pegasai at Lyra-Aveyon. The Pegasus-like form does not establish a Pegasus-system birthplace.
lineages.background: Winged horse-deer forms in the Amethyst founder family.
lineages.practice: Turn an imaginative idea into one small creative experiment you can share.
lineages.source: Dance for Life (A & A Deane, 2002), printed pp. 136-139; Voyagers II: The Secrets of Amenti (expanded edition), printed pp. 262-264
lineages.interpretation: Personality themes and practices are New Earth University interpretations, not an MCEO diagnostic method.

lineages.name: Azurites / Azurite Yani
lineages.locationNote: The source describes a Sirius B lineage and a council named Azurline-Sirius B. It does not supply a verified planetary address for a participant.
lineages.background: A composite feline, avian, land- and water-mammal expression associated with cooperation and guardianship in the narrative.
lineages.practice: Bring different skills or people together around a useful shared project.
lineages.source: Dance for Life (A & A Deane, 2002), printed pp. 136-139; Voyagers II: The Secrets of Amenti (expanded edition), printed pp. 262-264
lineages.interpretation: Personality themes and practices are New Earth University interpretations, not an MCEO diagnostic method.

lineages.name: Oraphim
lineages.location: Lyra and Sirius B ancestry; Taran / Earth human-seeding narrative
lineages.locationNote: This is a composite lineage narrative, not one exact star-system birthplace.
lineages.background: The texts connect Anuhazi and Azurite ancestry with the Oraphim-Angelic Human lineage. The supplied compilation also names Serres ancestry.
lineages.practice: Choose a spiritual value and give it a visible expression in your everyday work.
lineages.source: Dance for Life (A & A Deane, 2002), printed pp. 136-139; Voyagers II: The Secrets of Amenti (expanded edition), printed pp. 262-264; supplied reference
lineages.interpretation: Personality themes and practices are New Earth University interpretations, not an MCEO diagnostic method.

lineages.name: Feline Oraphim
lineages.location: Composite Oraphim lineage: Lyra / Sirius B associations
lineages.locationNote: An exact separate planet for this specialized form was not found in the checked primary passages.
lineages.background: The supplied materials depict a feline expression within the wider Oraphim family.
lineages.practice: Practice courageous visibility alongside a clear, respectful boundary.
lineages.source: Supplied Founder family races reference; wider Oraphim context in Dance for Life (A & A Deane, 2002), printed pp. 136-139
lineages.interpretation: Personality themes and practices are New Earth University interpretations, not an MCEO diagnostic method.

lineages.name: Avian Oraphim
lineages.location: Composite Oraphim lineage; Alcyone-Pleiades council association
lineages.locationNote: Dance for Life names avian Oraphim Serres in the Alcyone council. That association is not proof of personal origin.
lineages.background: The supplied illustrations show a winged or bird-like Oraphim expression.
lineages.practice: Teach one idea through a story, voice note, or brief video.
lineages.source: Dance for Life (A & A Deane, 2002), printed pp. 136-139; supplied reference
lineages.interpretation: Personality themes and practices are New Earth University interpretations, not an MCEO diagnostic method.

lineages.name: Cetacean Oraphim
lineages.location: Composite Oraphim lineage: Lyra / Sirius B associations
lineages.locationNote: A distinct exact origin planet for this specialized expression was not independently established.
lineages.background: The supplied materials depict a dolphin or whale-like Oraphim expression.
lineages.practice: Offer listening and presence while also protecting your own time and energy.
lineages.source: Supplied Founder family races reference; wider Oraphim context in Dance for Life (A & A Deane, 2002), printed pp. 136-139
lineages.interpretation: Personality themes and practices are New Earth University interpretations, not an MCEO diagnostic method.

lineages.name: Maharaji / Maharajhi
lineages.locationNote: The primary council passage uses the spelling Maharagi. Related spellings appear in the supplied references.
lineages.background: A Blue Human lineage associated with Azurite-Oraphim ancestry and the Sirius B council.
lineages.practice: Make an unfamiliar teaching understandable without overstating what you know.
lineages.source: Dance for Life (A & A Deane, 2002), printed pp. 136-139; Voyagers II: The Secrets of Amenti (expanded edition), printed pp. 262-264
lineages.interpretation: Personality themes and practices are New Earth University interpretations, not an MCEO diagnostic method.

lineages.name: Turaneusiam
lineages.location: Tara in the MCEO cosmology; subsequent Earth expressions
lineages.locationNote: Tara is a realm/planet name in the teachings; it is not a confirmed modern astronomical planet.
lineages.background: An original Taran Angelic Human race narrative, with later branches and Earth-seeding accounts.
lineages.practice: Build a regular rhythm for a gift you want to embody in ordinary life.
lineages.source: Voyagers II: The Secrets of Amenti (expanded edition), printed pp. 262-264; Voyagers II Taran narrative
lineages.interpretation: Personality themes and practices are New Earth University interpretations, not an MCEO diagnostic method.

lineages.name: Grandeyanas
lineages.location: Energy Matrix beyond the Time Matrix, in this cosmology
lineages.locationNote: The source describes a consciousness collective rather than a physical race with a planet of birth.
lineages.background: The first Primal Sound Field collective, connected with the Emerald order.
lineages.practice: Sit quietly with a core value, then make one decision that expresses it.
lineages.source: Dance for Life (A & A Deane, 2002), printed pp. 136-139
lineages.interpretation: Personality themes and practices are New Earth University interpretations, not an MCEO diagnostic method.

lineages.name: Wachayanas
lineages.location: Energy Matrix beyond the Time Matrix, in this cosmology
lineages.locationNote: A consciousness collective rather than a physical star-system population.
lineages.background: The second Primal Sound Field collective, connected with the Gold order.
lineages.practice: Combine a contemplative practice with a clear expression of what you learned.
lineages.source: Dance for Life (A & A Deane, 2002), printed pp. 136-139
lineages.interpretation: Personality themes and practices are New Earth University interpretations, not an MCEO diagnostic method.

lineages.name: Ramyanas
lineages.location: Energy Matrix beyond the Time Matrix, in this cosmology
lineages.locationNote: A consciousness collective rather than a race assigned to an exact physical planet.
lineages.background: The third Primal Sound Field collective, connected with the Amethyst order.
lineages.practice: Make one compassionate choice that respects both your needs and another person’s.
lineages.source: Dance for Life (A & A Deane, 2002), printed pp. 136-139
lineages.interpretation: Personality themes and practices are New Earth University interpretations, not an MCEO diagnostic method.

glossary.MCEO: A body of spiritual teachings attributed to the Melchizedek Cloister Emerald Order.
glossary.Keylontic science: The teachings’ spiritual framework of consciousness, energetic patterns, and cosmic origins; not an established scientific discipline.
glossary.Founder order: A broad consciousness family within the teachings; related expressions can overlap.
glossary.Yanas: Consciousness collectives described beyond physical star-system life.
glossary.Time Matrix: The teachings’ map of realms and levels of manifestation.
glossary.Angelic Human: A spiritual account of human potential and origin within these teachings.
glossary.Soul blueprint: An invitation to explore values, gifts, and possible contributions, rather than a fixed diagnosis.
glossary.The 144,000: A symbolic spiritual frame for service and leadership; this assessment cannot verify membership in a chosen group.
